source: derived from the ENGINE's own validators: src/packs/loader.js validatePackManifest / validateEnvClaims (+ loadPacks rows live in the pin test). Mutations are applied to a REAL shipped manifest from corpus.json (next-middleware-shapes) - no invented shapes

spec.title: The packstruct spec, version 1
spec.source: dhaupin/packstruct spec/SPEC.md at SHA b0e305034c974ad133b83e3b1c3cb27094d1de46 (2026-10-24), committed byte-exact; verify with node labs/packstruct-backfill/verify-spec.mjs <packstruct-clone>
spec.specKeyGrammar: "<section>/<term>[/<term>...]": the section cites a SPEC heading (1-7); every term must appear VERBATIM in that section of the committed transcript - the pin test resolves each key against SPEC-v1.md, never against memory

note: specKey values were filled deliberately (2026-10-24) the moment SPEC v1 became addressable - transcribed against the committed transcript (SPEC-v1.md, pinned SHA) in the same review that landed them (dhaupin/crashtest#20 sequencing: fixtures transcribe the spec, never invent). Every host-owned shape row (R08-R19, A01, A02, A04) cites section 2's host-owned acknowledged-keys paragraph: the spec ACKNOWLEDGES the key and the HOST owns its shape rules - the granular engine cite stays in each row's hostRule. null is now a regression.
